post_title: H1B transfer 2026 - taking 2 weeks off between jobs
concerns_or_questions_summary: Currently on H-1B with Employer A and Employer B is filing the H-1B transfer in premium processing; plans 2 weeks' notice plus 2 weeks off (4-week total gap) before starting at Employer B. Asking whether the break is safe under maintenance of status, whether the notice period counts, how reasonable a short employment gap is in 2026, and what USCIS expects after the transfer petition is filed.
